mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id AS userId, r.segment_code AS segmentCode, r.segment_name AS segmentName, r.cluster_index AS clusterIndex, r.distance_to_center AS distanceToCenter, r.confidence_score AS confidenceScore, r.is_cold_start AS isColdStart, r.persona_summary AS personaSummary, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.status AS userStatus, u.create_time AS userCreateTime, f.order_count_90d AS orderCount90d, f.order_amount_90d AS orderAmount90d, f.avg_order_amount_90d AS avgOrderAmount90d, f.distinct_category_count_90d AS distinctCategoryCount90d, f.behavior_count_30d AS behaviorCount30d, f.view_count_30d AS viewCount30d, f.cart_count_30d AS cartCount30d, f.favorite_count_30d AS favoriteCount30d, f.purchase_behavior_count_30d AS purchaseBehaviorCount30d, f.active_days_30d AS activeDays30d, f.avg_duration_30d AS avgDuration30d, f.recency_order_days AS recencyOrderDays, f.recency_behavior_days AS recencyBehaviorDays, f.tenure_days AS tenureDays, f.raw_features AS rawFeatures, f.normalized_features AS normalizedFeatures FROM analytics_kmeans_user_result r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN analytics_kmeans_feature_snapshot f ON f.task_id = r.task_id AND f.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
